rightsAndTerms: The official Terms of Service contain a broad submissions clause.
For covered submissions, the clause states that submissions remain the property of Reggae Vibe Music Group and purports to grant all now-known or future rights throughout the universe.
The clause permits unrestricted commercial or other use without compensation.
The exact applicability of this generic clause to the specifically requested music-upload form is legally ambiguous and must be resolved before any upload.
